name: LDMX
summary: LDMX is a proposed dedicated missing-momentum experiment at SLAC End Station A, California.
detection_principle: Each electron's momentum and energy are measured before and after a thin target, selecting large missing momentum without corresponding calorimeter energy. Hadronic and finely segmented electromagnetic calorimeters reject photonuclear backgrounds.

results.summary: The paper gives expected MeV–GeV dark-sector sensitivity as design projections, rather than achieved exclusions.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
